notes.title: The Tyranian Saga Continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37756140/a2044ee8dcc44ddf74b57d93acece1a341fb3437.png[/img]

Hello there!

I am happy to announce that I just released a short demo prologue for my next project: [b]Tyrania Enforcers! [/b]Now hold up, there are a few things everyone should know first. This is just a short demo for the prologue, just to introduce the direction the story will continue on and to introduce the new characters.
The story will be from the perspective of an average civilian plus 2 soldiers and the events happen at the same time during the war in Tyrania. I added new features such as a[b] dynamic menu, blinking eyes, translations[/b] and more!



[b]Installation and Instructions[/b]

Tyrania Enforcers will eventually go to Steam when it is complete, but for a short prologue demo, I uploaded a zip file. You can find it on the itch.io page but in short:
[olist]
[*]Go to the itch.io page: [url=leviathanimation.itch.io/tyrania-enforcers.]Tyrania Enforcers[/url]
[*]Locate the download button and download the zip file.
[*]Extract the zip file.
[*]Locate the application "[i]Tyrania_Enforcers[/i]" inside the folder and run it.
[*]Enjoy!
[/olist]
Also, you can change the language in preferences, then select french or english.



[b]Updates and Release[/b]

The full release on steam will be... in a very long time o;
I love making animations cutscenes of military battles and stuff, and that takes soooo long to make so I expect the completion to be around [b]2022 or 2023[/b]. And there is also university too...
So knowing the release might take some time, I wanted the second story to be independant. You don't need to read the first story of Tyrania to understand the second one so if any of you forget about certain details, no worries!

This will probably be the last update here on Steam since it isn't too relevant to talk about my next visual novel here on this one. If you want to follow my progress or just message me in private, you can check out my twitter, where I go by the same name.
twitter.com/EdoTyrania

Added some artwork assets, but not too much.

I'm making this small update patch but basically I've fixed more little typos there and there (english isn't my first language). You can check out the topic post in discussions (community hub) I made a while ago with other people's suggestions.

Also, I will post an [b]announcement[/b] some time soon about [b]future projects[/b] and everything that I'll be working on, so look forward to that :)


So until next time, have a great day!
